mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth declines by >2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 5%, a sharp rise in housing starts signals overexuberance in the housing market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises >5% in 3 months when UNRATE < 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is above 6%, a sharp drop in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines >100k in 1 month when UNRATE > 6% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index above 3% signals an inflationary regime that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 1% in 1 month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances.
